description: Cycling Network is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This data set comprises the on and off road cycling infrastructure that makes up the cycling network. It includes City owned infrastructure (e.g., multiuse paths and protected bike lanes) as well as some spur routes and other private infrastructure. Cycling infrastructure type is defined here:. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation Planning & Traffic Management. Its tags are bike, bicycle, at, active transportation, pathway. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
